title: Old Ede gives a keepsake ('a warden's old watch-cloak: obtained... her husband's, kept forty years for someone to grow into') that stays in my inventory the whole game. The ending recap instead says 'Old Ede keeps her wicker house, watched now, warm in a dead man's cloak she finally let herself wear' — describing her as wearing the very item I am still carrying.
where: Ede's Wicker House / 'offer to see someone looks in on her' — final status 'how the realm remembers you'
